Both products are positive, the determinant is negative, and the positive Perron root is strictly increasing in trace for fixed determinant; the equality and universal order statements follow. The threshold polynomial 1-a_1a_2a_3-μC_±-μ³Q has one positive zero by strict decrease, and the exact rational witness has characteristic evaluation 9/32 versus -3/32 at one. One/two season permutations cannot change the spectrum. Executed SymPy identities and 1000 independently multiplied exact rational cases, which are auxiliary checks and not a replacement for proof.

originality.rationale: The main fully inspected close source, Cushing 2006, establishes periodic juvenile-adult fertility thresholds and a period-3 small-amplitude sensitivity coefficient. It does not in examined Sections 2–4 and Appendix state an exact determinant classification of every permutation of three arbitrary fixed seasonal vital-rate triplets for all common fertility multipliers, its isospectral surface and strict opposite-growth interval. General periodic matrix product theory and cyclic invariance are acknowledged. Targeted searches recovered no dominating or identical theorem; residual priority risk from uninspected older matrix-product literature remains explicitly documented.
residual_risks: An earlier matrix-product ordering theorem, general result for two-by-two positive matrix triple products, or population-model appendix could already imply the sign classification even without equivalent wording.
The 1994 Caswell–Trevisan and 2012 Caswell–Shyu full primary texts were not completely inspected, although an open 2019 successor chapter was read.
The result is specific to the zero-juvenile-stasis two-stage matrix form; it does not extend without proof to broader stage-structured matrices.

value.rationale: For periodically recurring early-life stages, the exact sign of a determinant of three seasonal demographic triples globally chooses the growth-optimal temporal orientation and its critical fertility threshold, independent of fertility scale; the smallest possible season number is proved and an explicit rational witness has opposite long-run growth signs. This gives a complete natural classification for stage-structured climate or management phase models, beyond routine numeric matrix multiplication, without claiming field applicability or stochastic extinction.
